s5_old_cells.title: Old Cells, New Faces
s5_old_cells._comment: Narrative N1. NG+ only (sentence >= 2). Veteran's block starts +10.

return.text: Cell 4 is occupied by someone who knew where the hooks were. You were renamed. It did not take.

effects.title: Old cells
effects.text: Returning inmates keep their habits. The Warden keeps the files.
